Topic.label: The Concept of a Quadratic Equation in One Variable

Question: The equation \((m-1)x^{(|m|+1)}+2x-3=0\) in \(x\) is a quadratic equation in one variable. Find the value of \(m\).
Solution: From \(|m|+1=2\), we get \(m=\pm1\). Also, the coefficient of the quadratic term satisfies \(m-1\ne0\), so \(m\ne1\). Therefore, \(m=-1\).
